_comment: Independent venues read through the generic schema.org adapter.
Curated rather than discovered: there is no registry of independent
cinemas to crawl, and a list of the ones a user actually cares about is
cheaper and more honest than pretending to enumerate them.
`markup` records what was observed at capture time:
usable      - ScreeningEvent nodes with real startDate values
decorative  - valid markup, empty startDate; raises IncompleteStructuredData
A decorative venue is not a broken config. It is a venue that needs a
per-venue HTML fallback parser, and it stays listed so that work is
visible instead of the venue silently vanishing.

venues.name: Film Forum
venues.notes: 56 ScreeningEvent nodes, every startDate empty. Format lives in the event title ('THE THIRD MAN in 35mm').
